items.quote: We will support a proposal that requests reasonable disclosure of the company’s governance, strategy, risk exposures and performance data related to material sustainability risks.
items.why: The proposal asks for reasonable, annual, non-proprietary disclosure on how Microsoft will meet its climate commitments, and the proponent notes growing emissions. The company says its existing disclosure is already extensive, so whether a real gap exists is a judgement call.
items.fact_needed: Check whether Microsoft's existing climate disclosures already cover transition-plan and scenario-analysis information, or leave a significant gap.
items.evidence_quote: shareholders request Microsoft disclose additional information illustrating how it will manage its climate commitments. This disclosure should be beyond existing disclosures, at reasonable cost, omitting proprietary information, and made annually.

items.quote: We will not support a proposal where the company does not appear to have significant gaps in their management or reporting of the relevant sustainability risk.
items.why: The board says it already describes its human rights due diligence processes publicly and the proposal names no specific information gap. I could not confirm a significant gap from the material read.
items.fact_needed: Compare Microsoft's existing human rights due diligence reporting with our public expectations on human rights to see whether there is a significant gap.
items.evidence_quote: it requests another report covering processes, governance mechanisms, and risk-management approaches that Microsoft already describes publicly.

items.quote: We will not support a proposal where the company does not appear to have significant gaps in their management or reporting of the relevant sustainability risk.
items.why: The board says the proposal identifies no information gap beyond existing disclosures. I could not confirm a significant gap in reporting on data operations in conflict areas from the material read.
items.fact_needed: Check whether Microsoft's reporting on data operations in conflict-affected areas has a significant gap against our expectations.
items.evidence_quote: The proposal does not identify specific information necessary for shareholders to evaluate Company performance that is not already available through Microsoft’s existing disclosures.

items.quote: We will support a proposal to separate the roles of chairperson and CEO.
items.why: Nadella holds both Chairman and CEO roles, and the proposal asks the board to require separate people in the two offices. The guideline supports this, so we vote against the board's recommendation.
items.evidence_quote: shareholders request the Board of Directors of Microsoft Corporation adopt a policy, and amend the governing documents as necessary, to require that two separate people hold the office of Chairman of the Board and the office of Chief Executive Officer
